0022600087.text: Both the Charlotte Hornets and Brooklyn Nets open their 2026-27 seasons, and neither has played a game yet this season. The Hornets are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions with Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Grayson Allen (knee soreness), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), Kylan Boswell (knee) and Moussa Diabate (elbow), while Brooklyn has Tyler Bilodeau out with a shoulder injury. Charlotte won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-86 victory in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026, the most recent meeting between the teams.
